description: This file defines the EntryCollection class within the OrangeHRM LDAP plugin. The class manages a collection of lookup setting pairs, providing methods to count the total number of entries and retrieve the collection.

classes.name: EntryCollection
classes.description: A collection class that aggregates EntryCollectionLookupSettingPair objects and provides counting and retrieval functionalities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the collection with a variable number of EntryCollectionLookupSettingPair objects.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the total count of entries across all contained EntryCollectionLookupSettingPair objects, caching the result for subsequent calls.

methods.name: getCollections
methods.description: Returns the array of EntryCollectionLookupSettingPair objects contained in this collection.
